verdict.rationale: Ollama runs a local HTTP API server at localhost:11434 that serves its models, and documents that OpenAI clients can connect to it. Its OpenAI compatibility is explicitly limited to "a subset of the OpenAI API," which is a documented limitation on the story's core requirement. missing for 10: details of which OpenAI endpoints and parameters are covered, explicit evidence that the server works with any loaded model, and independent hands-on confirmation of OpenAI-client compatibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: Connect OpenAI clients to Ollama. Ollama supports a subset of the OpenAI API
Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
